editorial:
Imagine trying to do something sweet for your partner, but it goes wrong in the funniest way possible. That is exactly what happens here. You get to meet Oddy, a guy who just wants to give his girlfriend Penny a magical surprise party. He spends the whole first act sneaking around and setting up decorations, but the vibe shifts quickly. Penny comes home and thinks there is a dangerous intruder in her house. Instead of calling the police, she decides to hunt the intruder down herself using whatever she can find in the kitchen. It is a wild ride that turns a romantic gesture into a chaotic game of cat and mouse.

The acting is top-notch, and the timing of the jokes really lands. You will love how the tension builds up until everything explodes into a big mess. While some parts feel a bit repetitive, the twist keeps you guessing. If you are looking for a lighthearted night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer to own your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a date night or a hangout with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Penny finally corners Oddy in the living room, thinking he is a burglar. Just as she is about to attack him, the lights flash on and all their friends jump out to yell surprise. The big twist is that Penny actually enjoyed the thrill of the hunt more than the party. They end up laughing about it and decide to spend the rest of the night eating cake together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a wild twist.
